'''''Eldritch''''' was a [[Submarine/Legends|submersible]] [[Starship/Legends|starship]] operated by [[Corellian Security Forces|CorSec]]. The vessel was lost during a sting operation when it when it was fired upon by [[Quekka Trench Station]]'s [[Torpedo/Legends|torpedo]] defenses.<ref name="HS" />
